scope: Refresh the project operating adapter, work order, startup receipt, generated compatibility views, and regression/CI contracts to the current Base while preserving all product paths.
approval_scope: User explicit request: detailed Base fresh-read and project-specific update of work order, structure, and contracts; no game-system expansion.

entries.observed_pattern: A material workflow/adapter change must use a repository-owned reuse/benchmark receipt, scoped hygiene inventory, thin project adaptation, exact Base validation, and an exit learning handoff.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Ten Paces already owns repository-first authority, player-facing ten-game reverse-engineering, runtime visual evidence, and four local skills. The Base procedure is reused as a thin route only; project game rules and visual meaning are not copied or replaced.

entries.source_and_evidence: Ten Paces main@4032cf550295da6d55646a8fb64fb27acaf1ddc3: AGENTS.md, docs/BASE_RULES_VERSION.md, PROJECT_TOTAL_PLANNING_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_DELIVERY_INSTRUCTION.md, ACTIVE_CONTEXT.md, current_user_planning_status.json, PROJECT_BASE_ADAPTER.json, generated adapter views, current runtime-capture owners, and live PR metadata.
entries.observed_pattern: The project already separates repository canon from historical migration sources and protects data/, src/, scenes/, assets/, addons/, and project.godot from governance-only work.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: The requested change is operating-contract-only. Existing card, combat, capture, asset, and platform evidence remains the consumer source; no new player-facing design or irrelevant game benchmark is introduced.

entries.source_and_evidence: Base current commits 56dce2ac, a54966fc, 19fb7b43, 5f22096c, 781dfe8f, d060ffab, and 19355b7e after the v9.4.4 finalization.
entries.observed_pattern: Feature-level contracts, conditional Blueprint/wireframe, bounded runtime capture, benchmark-first intake, receipt/hygiene gates, and active-surface correction are conditional safeguards rather than automatic product work.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Use these only when their actual trigger exists: a changed feature has a consumer, a player-facing system needs a Blueprint, or a changed screen needs a capture. Do not create wireframes/captures or delete archives merely to mirror Base.

evidence_and_exit.project_only_lessons: A current Base update is safe only when it records the project-specific ADOPT/ADAPT/REJECT boundary and validates the actual project entrypoints rather than copying Base templates.
